Bahirakalpitā vṛttir mahāvidehā tataḥ prakāśāvaraṇakṣayaḥ /III.43/
Bahir-akalpitā vṛttir mahā-videhā tataḥ prakāśa-āvaraṇa-kṣayaḥ /III.43/

« L'activité [du mental] non construite [mentalement] est la mahāvidehā 'grande
[activité] sans recours au corps'
1669 ; de là, disparition de ce qui voile la lumière. »

Śārīrād bahir manaso vṛtti-lābho videhā nāma dhāraṇā / Sa yadi śarīra-pratiṣṭhasya manaso
bahir-vṛtti-mātreṇa bhavati sā kalpitā–ity ucyate / Yā tu śarīra-nirapekṣā bahir-bhūtasya–eva
manaso bahir-vṛttiḥ sā khalv akalpitā / Tatra kalpitayā sādhayanty akalpitāṃ mahā-videhām
iti yathā para-śarīrāṇy āviśanti yoginaḥ / Tataś ca dhāraṇātaḥ prakāśa-ātmano buddhi-
sattvasya yad āvaraṇaṃ kleśa-karma-vipāka-trayaṃ
1670 rajas-tamo-mūla�
